plans.label: (a) Pay on signature
plans.formula: S = participant agreements signed (signed_at in plan period) credited to the rep; Q = quota_funded_annual (prorated for YTD: Q × days_elapsed/365), applied to signatures. variable = unit × multipliers.signed × min(S, Q) + unit × multipliers.signed × accelerator × max(S − Q, 0). No clawback, no ADV kicker.
plans.behavior: Rewards signing as many agreements as possible, including marginal accounts that never fund or trade.
risks: Activation work is dumped on RevOps; signed→funded and funded→trade conversion is nobody's number.
Pays out on accounts that generate zero ADV or fees, so variable cost per Active account is the highest of the three plans.
Encourages pulling signatures forward at quarter-end regardless of KYC readiness.

plans.label: (b) Pay on funded
plans.formula: F = accounts with funded_at in plan period credited to the rep, ordered by funded_at; k = position in that order; Q = quota_funded_annual (prorated for YTD). pay_k = unit × multipliers.funded × (accelerator if k > Q else 1). clawback_k = clawback_pct × pay_k if the account has no qualifying trade (≥10 contracts, non-self-match) within clawback_days of funded_at and that window has closed by as_of. variable = Σ pay_k − Σ clawback_k. No ADV kicker.
plans.behavior: Rewards getting accounts through KYC and funded, with a light penalty when they never trade.
risks: Funded-but-dormant accounts still keep 50% of the payout; a one-lot trade avoids the clawback entirely.
No pay for ADV, so a $30/day C&I account earns the same as a 400-contract/day prop firm.
AE attention ends at first trade; habit formation (Active) is unowned.

plans.label: (c) Funded + activation + ADV (recommended)
plans.formula: For each funded account i credited to the rep, ordered by funded_at (k = position; Q = quota_funded_annual, prorated for YTD), a_k = accelerator if k > Q else 1. Milestones: M_i = multipliers.funded + multipliers.active_60d × [Active (≥4 distinct trading days in trailing 30) reached within 60d of funded_at] + multipliers.active_21d_bonus × [Active reached within 21d of funded_at]; milestone_i = unit × M_i × a_k. Clawback_i = clawback_pct × unit × multipliers.funded × a_k if no qualifying trade (≥10 contracts, non-self-match) within clawback_days of funded_at (window closed by as_of). Kicker: C_i = non-self-match contracts traded by i in its first 365 days after funded_at (up to as_of); credit_i = lp_kicker_credit if is_liquidity_partner else 1; E_i = C_i × credit_i; base_i = min(adv_kicker_cap, adv_kicker_per_1k × E_i / 1000); capped contracts E'_i = base_i / adv_kicker_per_1k × 1000; uplift = (adv_kicker_accel − 1) × adv_kicker_per_1k × max(0, Σ E'_i − V) / 1000 where V = volume_target_contracts_annual (prorated for YTD). variable = Σ milestone_i − Σ clawback_i + Σ base_i + uplift.
plans.behavior: Rewards fast activation of high-ADV fits: the rep earns most when funded accounts form a weekly trading habit within 21–60 days and keep trading.
risks: Calibration: unit $2,000 pays the $72k account component only at 100% activation; at the 70% Active target an on-quota rep earns ~$86k ($57.6k milestones + $28k kicker at volume target). See COMP_PLAN.md §4.
Reps may steer toward prop/fund accounts with high ADV priors; the queue balance weight (B) and hedger-mix scorecard review counter this.
Pushed one-lot trades: mitigated because milestones require Active (≥4 days) and the clawback uses qualifying trades (≥10 contracts).
Kicker lag: volume pays over 12 months, so payout timing must be quarterly to stay motivating.
